search_f_gold: search for a target value in an array where adjacent elements differ by at most 1
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against multiple parameter sets and count successful matches
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses abs(arr[i] - x) to skip elements during search
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold efficient search algorithm that skips indices based on distance to target
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative indices
